mathematical_content: Each stored guarded quotient-rank cut (sat(q1) AND sat(q2) => N_out >= R) is replaced by the unconditional linear inequality N_out + (w_q1-r_q1) + (w_q2-r_q2) >= R, i.e. sum_{p coeff} x_p >= R + r_q1 + r_q2 where coeff(p) = 1_{outside(p)} + 1_{q1(p)} + 1_{q2(p)}. No saturation Boolean variables; pure ILP.
